semantic_reason: The issue reports an actual failure: send_download/3 emits an invalid Content-Disposition header when the filename contains spaces/commas, causing browsers to reject the response (ERR_RESPONSE_HEADERS_MULTIPLE_CONTENT_DISPOSITION). The PR changes existing encoding behavior in Phoenix.Controller.encode_filename/2 to use URI.char_unreserved?/1, correcting an error rather than introducing a new capability. The added/modified test asserts the corrected header, consistent with a bug fix. Unrelated changed files are patch bloat, not evidence of new functionality.
